stories.label: Iran crisis — war preparations intensify as nuclear ultimatum deadline nears
stories.summary: Deadline ~Feb 23-24. Pezeshkian says Iran won't bow to US pressure. Witkoff says Trump puzzled Iran hasn't capitulated. Not selected this cycle — heavily covered (16 articles), no new breakthrough or breakdown yet. Next cycle is critical as deadline passes.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia conflict — Russia strikes Kyiv ahead of 4th invasion anniversary
stories.summary: Russia escalating missile strikes on Kyiv ahead of the 4th anniversary of the full-scale invasion (Feb 24). Lviv terror attack earlier this week expanded the war's reach to western Ukraine. Diplomatic talks remain stalled.

stories.label: US tariff upheaval — nations cut bilateral deals as 15% regime takes hold
stories.summary: Tariffs at 15% via Section 122. Capital flight from US markets accelerating. SCOTUS struck down IEEPA tariffs 6-3. Indonesia cutting bilateral deals. Not directly selected this cycle but the Indonesia trade deal story advances this arc.

stories.label: Pakistan strikes inside Afghanistan — Kabul reports dozens killed
stories.summary: Pakistan escalated from border strikes to cross-border operations inside Afghan territory. Kabul reporting dozens killed and wounded. Taliban government denies harboring militants. Major escalation in Pakistan-Afghanistan tensions.

stories.label: Brazil's Lula visits India with largest-ever delegation, challenges Trump on tariffs
stories.summary: Lula visiting India with largest-ever Brazilian delegation. Publicly calling for Trump to treat all countries equally. Lee-Lula summit Monday. India-Brazil critical minerals deal signed. Global South coordination on tariffs emerging.

stories.label: Indonesia confirms bilateral trade deal with Trump amid tariff chaos
stories.summary: Indonesia — world's 4th most populous nation — secures bilateral trade deal with Trump amid 15% global tariff. Template for how SE Asian nations navigate the trade war with individual deals.

stories.label: Nature: Agentic AI system diagnoses rare diseases with traceable reasoning
stories.summary: Published in Nature: an agentic AI that can diagnose rare diseases with explainable reasoning. 300M people worldwide affected by rare diseases, most face years-long diagnostic odysseys.

stories.label: Nature RCT proves X's algorithm measurably shifts political attitudes
stories.summary: Randomized controlled trial in Nature proves X/Twitter's recommendation algorithm measurably shifts users' political attitudes. Most rigorous evidence yet that algorithmic feeds shape political views.

stories.label: Israeli settlers declare new settlement deep inside Palestinian Hebron
stories.summary: Settlers establishing new settlement inside one of Palestine's most densely populated cities. IDF raids and arrests preceded settler entry at Jabal Jalles. US ambassador's remarks supporting Israeli expansion condemned by 14 nations.

stories.label: Memory chip competition — Samsung reclaims DRAM lead amid Chinese challenge
stories.summary: Samsung regained global DRAM market leadership in Q4. CXMT undercutting DDR4 by ~50%. Competition intensifying on mature node memory.

stories.label: North Korea Workers' Party Congress — Kim outlines new five-year goals
stories.summary: Kim Jong Un outlined new five-year economic and military goals at Workers' Party Ninth Congress. S. Korea/US postponed announcement of annual military drills date.

stories.label: IS declares new campaign against Syria's post-Assad government
stories.summary: IS released first spokesperson audio in 2 years, declared new campaign against Sharaa's government. Claimed attacks in Raqqa and Deir al-Zor. Al Monitor reports two new attacks on Syrian army.

stories.label: Sudan war — Museveni hosts RSF leader Dagalo for dialogue
stories.summary: Uganda's Museveni hosting RSF leader Dagalo for dialogue. UN crossed genocide threshold. Not selected this cycle — no major new development.

stories.label: Israel-Lebanon ceasefire collapse — Hezbollah declares resistance only option
stories.summary: Israeli strikes continue in Lebanon. Hezbollah says resistance is only option. Ceasefire effectively dead. Not selected — ongoing but no major new development.

stories.label: Five European nations pledge drone defense production using Ukrainian expertise
stories.summary: E5 nations pledge to leverage Ukraine's battlefield drone expertise for low-cost air defense production.

stories.label: Ethiopia-Tigray-Eritrea: Troop movements raise renewed conflict fears
stories.summary: Military troop movements near Eritrea-Tigray border. 2022 Pretoria peace agreement may be unraveling.

stories.label: Trump to visit China March 31-April 2 for summit with Xi
stories.summary: Trump to visit China March 31-April 2. Now colored by tariff escalation to 15% and Australian warship transit.

stories.label: Chinese chipmaker CXMT undercuts global DDR4 prices by half
stories.summary: CXMT offering DDR4 at ~50% below Samsung/SK Hynix/Micron. Competition intensifying on mature node memory.

stories.label: Australian warship transits Taiwan Strait tracked by Chinese navy
stories.summary: Australian warship sailed through Taiwan Strait with PLA Navy tracking. AUKUS presence strengthening. British nuclear sub arrived in Perth.

stories.label: Gel material helps mini spinal cords heal from injury
stories.summary: Gel helps spinal cord organoids recover from injury. Potential breakthrough for paralysis treatments.

stories.label: 70B-parameter LLM runs on single consumer GPU via NVMe bypass
stories.summary: Running Llama 3.1 70B on a single RTX 3090 by routing data directly from NVMe to GPU. Democratizes access to powerful AI on consumer hardware.

stories.label: Wall Street exodus — investors shifting billions from US to overseas markets
stories.summary: US investors moving billions into emerging markets, Europe, Japan. Direct consequence of tariff chaos.

stories.label: Germany's CDU/CSU seeks social media ban for under-14s
stories.summary: Germany's ruling CDU/CSU passed motion for social media ban for under-14s with digital age verification.

stories.label: Philippine senator demands SCS pushback from disputed Thitu Island
stories.summary: Philippine senator visited Thitu Island to call for deepening defense partnerships against Chinese encroachment.

stories.label: Wikipedia bans Archive.today over DDoS attacks and altered captures
stories.summary: Wikipedia deprecated Archive.today over DDoS attacks and altered captures.

stories.label: NASA Artemis II delayed past March over SLS rocket issue
stories.summary: Artemis II pushed from March to at least April. Further delays expected.

stories.label: Ancient Australian salt caverns explored as massive energy storage
stories.summary: Queensland salt caverns explored for compressed-air energy storage at grid scale.
